item.title: Pgtestdb's template cloning approach to testing is fast
item.description:
📝 It uses a custom set of test helpers that isolate test cases based on schema, an approach that’s slower than test transactions, but which has some advantages: In Postgres a schema is lighter weight than a database, so the schema-based approach has that edge. River’s test helpers have a useful optimization in that they’ll create as many test schemas as Go’s instantaneous parallelization requires, but keep them pooled as test cases finish. when testing across schema versions, each test case must only reuse a schema on the same version it expects.
🔗 Read more: https://brandur.org/fragments/pgtestdb
